basis: SEACOR Marine’s Q3 2024 results release was the earliest qualifying issuer communication found. Consolidated GAAP operating revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2024 was $68,916,000, down 10.4% from $76,900,000 in Q3 2023. The 95% threshold was $73,055,000. Both amounts come from the same operating-revenue row in the issuer’s comparative income statement.

coverage.detail: May 1 Q1 release. The CEO discussed U.S. project delays, strong demand for premium liftboats and vessel mobilizations expected in Q2. He gave no numeric Q3 consolidated revenue outlook.

July 3 investor presentation, dated July 2. Slide 16 modeled annual revenue under different fleet day rates and utilization assumptions and expressly disclaimed guidance. Slide 17 used annualized pro forma figures. Neither supplied a Q3 revenue bound.

July 31 Q2 release. The $69,867,000 reported revenue was for the quarter ended June 30. Management cited $403.9 million of backlog including options, with an average contract duration of approximately one year, and expected utilization to improve for the rest of 2024. It gave no Q3 revenue amount or year-over-year range.

September 10 disclosure for the CEO’s September 11 Pareto conference presentation. Slide 20 modeled annual revenue of $280 million to $353 million across day-rate scenarios and expressly disclaimed guidance. The scenarios established no upper bound for Q3.
September 19 release announced a board appointment and contained no quarterly sales update.

The issuer’s archive lists the July and September investor presentations, followed by December. It lists no Q2 earnings call. Searches for preliminary results, updated guidance and dated public management remarks through October 29 found no earlier qualifying Q3 figure.

October 30 results exhibit. The consolidated income statement reports operating revenues in thousands of 68,916 for Q3 2024 and 76,900 for Q3 2023. It presents asset disposition gains and impairments separately from revenue.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s investor-relations release displays October 30, 2024 at 4:27 PM EDT. The matching SEC Exhibit 99.1 is dated October 30, 2024 and marked for immediate release.
